base_model_revision_note: No immutable base-model revision was included in the supplied bundle.
pipeline: Product LoRA detection followed by a role LoRA query for each detected product; paragraph-only input.

instructions.prod: annotate the products in the paragraph.
instructions.role: annotate the reaction roles in the paragraph.

aggregation: Select the product query with the most entities across the seven ROLE_TAGS; break ties by last query. Reactants comes from this selected query; all_products contains products found at stage 1.
si_s13: Role presence, not correctness. Reactant presence uses the selected primary-product query; product presence uses all_products.
